Question: I saw a dream that me and my two sisters,1 & 2, are going somewhere..sister 2 is a bit ahead of us..we see some dogs on our way..they bark at sister 2..she runs while scared and dog follows her to bite her..she gets disappeared in a side street..me and sister 1 run to find her..we also encounter some dogs barking at us..then we suddenly hear a loud cry of sister2..`plz guide me as soon as possible.. Answer ID: 10278 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 133/92=H/1429) These are satanic whisperings and high worldly ambitions which you saw in dream in the form of barking and attacking dogs. May Allah protect us all! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
